findings.claim: 約65%全球銷售經獨立經銷商，前兩大經銷商合計約占總銷售20%（2023–2025 三年皆約此水準），通路結構未見變化。
findings.excerpt: Approximately 65 percent of our global sales are transacted through independent distributors. Sales to our two largest distributors in 2025, 2024, and 2023, which are attributable to all three segments, were approximately 20 percent of our total sales.

findings.claim: Q4 FY2025 財報會議：Plex 與 Fiix 持續新增客戶，並以新的 go-to-market 夥伴擴充既有業務團隊（夥伴導向銷售補強，非取代經銷）。
findings.excerpt: as we augment our existing sales force with new go-to-market partners

findings.claim: Rockwell 自 2026-10-01 起調整 Global Sales & Marketing、Intelligent Devices、Lifecycle Services 的領導職責（組織調整，細節未讀）。
findings.source: produktion.de Rockwell Automation stellt Führung neu auf
findings.excerpt: Ab 1. Oktober 2026 wechseln die Verantwortlichkeiten in Global Sales & Marketing, Intelligent Devices und Lifecycle Services. Stefan Weinzierl Stefan Weinzierl Chefredakteur

note: 搜尋未找到2026年經銷商被取代、D2C化或通路中斷的來源；訂閱／ARR與Connected Enterprise平台說法僅見二手站，未取得可逐字原文；10/1/2026 銷售組織調整見德文 produktion.de 報導，僅有 clue。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
